annotations.title: Send an enquiry to ATI Lab

description: Sends the user's enquiry to ATI Lab's Growth Team, who reply by email, and returns a reference ID. The enquiry is recorded in ATI Lab's CRM. Use it only when the user has asked to contact ATI Lab and has given their name and email. Show the user the exact message first and call this only after they confirm; set user_confirmed to true to record that. Never invent contact details.

agent.description: Optional: the assistant sending this, e.g. "Claude".

email.description: The user's email, where the Growth Team will reply.

message.description: What the user needs, in their words (at least one sentence).

user_confirmed.description: True only after the user approved this exact message.

name: atilab_send_enquiry
title: Send an enquiry to ATI Lab
